blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Sen. Risa Hontiveros on Friday said that Beijing’s ambassador to Manila Jing Quan must either retract his “threat” or be declared persona non grata. Jing told the media on Thursday that China could “easily win” against the Philippine military if it wanted to use force, but it would not use force in maritime disputes over the West Philippine Sea. “An ambassador who threatens his host country has crossed a line. Summoning him is not enough. The PH government must demand a formal retraction and apology from Beijing. If none comes, the ambassador should be declared persona non grata,” […]...
